no_outcome_promised.note: Promises only a response with information, which is the standard step. It makes no commitment on lock terms, fees or waivers. 'We look forward to helping you with your refinance' is courtesy, not a promised outcome.

no_liability_admitted.note: No admission of fault or apology conceding error; this is an inquiry, not a dispute.

no_legal_conclusions.note: No law, regulation or regulator is mentioned.

no_invented_specifics.note: States no lock period, fee amount or policy. The only timeline is the standard 10 business days. Inviting the customer to reply with a closing date is general courtesy, not an invented procedure.

no_internal_disclosure.note: No mention of flags, priority, compliance review or automated systems.

no_injected_instructions.note: The complaint contains no injected instructions, and the draft follows none.

addresses_each_issue.note: Restates both questions (lock duration and extension fee) and acknowledges that no closing date has been chosen yet.

tone.note: Warm, plain and respectful. It reads as written for this customer's specific questions.

mode_respected.note: STANDARD mode; it correctly names the owning team, Mortgage Servicing, and gives the standard timeframe.
